messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Where is rstan?
parts:
Hi Paramjit,

Looks like you're installing under Windows. You're actually having trouble installing Rcpp before getting to the installation of RStan. Can you verify that you've got all the requisites for RStan installed?

See: https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/wiki/RStan-Getting-Started#prerequisites
And that'll point you to installing RTools: https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/wiki/Install-Rtools-for-Windows



Daniel
